name: War Inc: Rising Gem Spending Guide — Best Value for Your Gems
title: War Inc: Rising Gem Spending Guide — Best Value and Optimization
meta_description: Learn the best ways to spend gems in War Inc: Rising. Permanent vs Limited summon, energy refills, event spending, and common gem mistakes to avoid.
author: Klown Kollege

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.content:
Gems are the most valuable currency in War Inc: Rising. Spend your first 10,000 on Permanent Summon scrolls for roster depth. Use Permanent Summon for 80% of your gem spending; save 20% for Limited Summon events featuring S+ tier Mythics. Never spend gems on speed-ups, shop resources, or refreshing daily missions.

Here's everything you need to know about spending gems efficiently — from your first week to endgame optimization.

sections.heading: Your First 10,000 Gems
sections.content:
Spend these on Permanent Summon scrolls. Building a broad roster early gives you flexibility for different game modes and events. Avoid limited banners until you have a core team.

Set aside 500 gems for energy refills during events that offer Mythic shards. Those events are the best early-game use of gems.

The temptation to chase a shiny Limited Banner hero is real, but a deep roster beats a narrow one every time.

sections.heading: Permanent vs Limited Summon
sections.content:
Permanent Summon: Consistent value. Guarantees progress toward your next Legendary or Mythic through the pity system. Best for building long-term roster depth.

Limited Summon: Higher rates for specific heroes but resets your pity counter if you don't hit the banner. Use this when you need one specific meta-defining hero.

Optimal split: 80% Permanent, 20% Limited. Use Permanent for core progression, Limited only when chasing S+ tier Mythics like Light Seeker or Radiant Warrior.

sections.heading: Energy Refills: When They're Worth It
sections.content:
Energy refills cost 50 gems. Worth it during:
- Events with Mythic shard rewards
- Double-drop campaigns
- Forge Stone farming sessions

NOT worth it for normal daily farming. The daily free energy and event claim rewards cover baseline needs.

A common mistake is using refills every day just because you have gems. Only refill when the rewards are boosted.

sections.heading: What NOT to Spend Gems On
sections.content:
Here are the traps that waste gems:
- Building construction speed-ups. Time is free. Just wait.
- Resources (gold, wood) from the shop. Terrible value per gem.
- Refreshing daily missions. The return is minimal.
- Random hero shards in the shop. Targeted summoning is more efficient.
- Speed-ups of any kind. Patience saves gems.

Follow these rules and your gems will go much further.
